summary: Validated 4 new capabilities: (A) dealer chat send triggers customer email fire-and-forget while still returning 200 and storing the message; (B) callback scheduling — future scheduled_at -> 'scheduled' + persisted, no scheduled_at -> 'pending' (sim), past scheduled_at -> immediate 'pending' (sim); (C) cron /api/cron/callbacks — 401 without/with wrong Bearer, 200 with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, and a scheduled callback with a due (past) scheduled_at flips to 'pending' (sim) after cron runs with a 'Scheduled callback ... due' timeline note; (D) recording sim path — GET /api/dealer/connect/recording/{call_id} returns 404 with friendly 'not available yet' detail on a sim call. Backend: 35/35 pytest tests pass (9 new tests added across TestDealerChatEmail, TestCallbackScheduling, TestCronCallbacks, TestRecordingSimulation404). Frontend: customer /dashboard incident detail exposes callback-phone-input, callback-time-input (datetime-local), request-callback-btn; submitting with a future time surfaces toast "Callback scheduled — we'll call at your chosen time"; submitting with no time surfaces "Callback requested — the dealer team will call you back". Regression on dealer /dealer: incident detail still renders recordings-section, chat-thread, chat-input, chat-send-btn — dealer message posts and is visible in thread (verified 'Dealer regression UI msg TEST').
critical_code_review_comments: server.request_callback still doesn't touch incident updated_at when appending the timeline entry (carried over from iter 3) — minor consistency issue.
process_due_callbacks catches Exception around _place_outbound and defaults to 'pending' — good; consider recording last_error on the callback doc for observability.
cron_callbacks uses hmac.compare_digest — correct constant-time compare. Good.

notify_customer_chat is awaited inside dealer_chat_send — if Resend is slow this blocks the response. Consider offloading to BackgroundTasks so the endpoint truly stays fire-and-forget (spec says 'best-effort'). Currently the endpoint still returns 200 even on send failure because _assert_safe_email/send_email should not raise, but any latency is user-visible.
Recording auto-link S3 lookup is LIVE-only and not exercised here; ensure it's wrapped in try/except so a mis-configured bucket doesn't 500 (couldn't verify in sim).

rca of the issue: No functional bugs. All 4 targeted features (dealer chat email trigger, callback scheduling future/none/past, cron auth + due-flip, recording sim 404) verified end-to-end. Customer UI callback scheduling toasts confirmed via Playwright.
